Priya (People Ops): Quick sync 0m - Sofia requests H-1B amendment for promotion to Staff and a 3-week remote trip to Portugal (June 6-26). Can we confirm steps?
Arun K (Eng Manager): I support the promotion. New title: Staff ML Engineer. New base: USD 205,000. Duties expanded to own cross-team inference orchestration and SR-ops.
Sofia M (Staff ML Engineer): Confirmed title and salary. I'll be remote Portugal June 6-26 for family. Want to ensure no benefits/payroll gaps.
Lynn (Immigration Counsel): Amendment required for title/duty change. We'll prepare LCA + amended petition. Need updated job description, signed acceptance, passport copy, and remote-work memo. Timeline: LCA ~7 business days, USCIS receipt 2-6 weeks unless premium.
Payroll Bot: Short international travel (<30 days) allowed on US payroll. Upload remote-work form and passport. Benefits continue if paid payroll continues; if travel >30 days re-review.
Priya (People Ops): Action items: 1) Sofia to upload signed promotion acceptance + passport (done via DM). 2) Arun to DM final manager blurb for job duties. 3) Priya to prepare remote-work memo and amendment checklist. Target: LCA submit Apr 28.
Arun K (Eng Manager): DM sent with blurb: "Lead cross-team model sharding, own latency SLOs, mentor senior ICs, drive SR-ops roadmap." Use that in packet.
Sofia M (Staff ML Engineer): Uploaded signed acceptance and passport to secure HR folder. Also completed remote-work form.
Lynn (Immigration Counsel): Recommend premium processing? If yes, 15-calendar-day turnaround. Cost needs budget sign-off (~$2,500). Otherwise expect multi-week delay.
Arun K (Eng Manager): Approve premium processing cost up to $2,500 charged to SR-ops. Go ahead if it speeds up start date.
Priya (People Ops): Noted. Lynn, proceed with LCA prep. I'll build packet checklist and route to Legal for review. Payroll, confirm we can process payroll while Sofia is in Portugal (files uploaded).
Payroll Bot: Confirmed - payroll will continue for the <30 day period. Ensure W-4 on file and local tax residency note if requested. Upload completed forms to /payroll/sofia_m/.
Lynn (Immigration Counsel): I'll draft employer letter including clause: "employee remains on Redwood payroll and benefits during temporary paid travel abroad" and include the amended duties. Legal review 24-48 hrs after packet ready.
Priya (People Ops): Great. Target: submit LCA Apr 28, file amendment with premium if requested by Apr 30. Sofia, we'll update you if anything blocks benefits. Please ack when you get this.
Sofia M (Staff ML Engineer): Ack 00% thanks. Appreciate the quick turnaround.
people-ops-bot: Thread saved to #people-ops for audit records.
